name: Cryonic-Veil
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an ancient meteor crater.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
the spatial rift remnant bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
